interpretation: Every legacy issue is classified by its actual claim type. Specific factory-documented mechanisms and documented campaigns are not frequency or completeness claims. Other categories are not established recurring design defects. Original issue sources and exact applicability are authoritative. Do not broaden or change their scope from this manifest.

categories.factory_documented_mechanism: The original source reports a specific fault cause/design or component vulnerability. Existence/scope only, not fleet incidence.
categories.factory_safety_campaign: Manufacturer/regulator campaign or safety nonconformance; campaign population/repair instructions must not imply observed failures.
categories.suspected_factory_mechanism: Factory source reports a hypothesis, not a verified cause or measured failure rate.
categories.diagnostic_nonunique: Diagnostic ambiguity, symptom differential, or failure scenario without a single proved original factory mechanism.
categories.parts_fitment_dependency: Part/application, hardware architecture, conditional service kit or interchangeable-product research; not proof of failure.
categories.maintenance_service: Manufacturer service conditions, installation hazards or maintenance requirements; not a systemic factory defect.
categories.source_scope_conflict: Source discrepancy, copied year folder, market exclusion, or unreliable seller claim; needs original applicability/revision review.
categories.vehicle_safety_inspection: Physical inspection, corrosion or vehicle-instance safety concern; original-factory defect not established by the record.
categories.research_evidence_gate: Missing safety-history or source identity that prevents verification; not a technical failure.
